test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT impacted by the cortex?
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Attention and disobedience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** passage mentions** that awareness, perception, attention, memory, and language are all impacted by the cortex.
 
• **Disobedience **is not listed as one of the functions impacted by the cortex.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
